_instructions: This is the universal tap credentials file used by tap_validator.py
to run LIVE discovery and sync checks against the real API.
1. Copy the fields from your tap's sample_config.json into this file.
2. Replace all placeholder values (YOUR_... / <VALUE>) with real credentials.
3. Pass this file to the validator:  --tap-config tap_credentials.json
All keys starting with '_' are metadata (ignored by the validator).
They will NOT be passed to the tap executable.
The validator detects placeholder values and falls back to static
analysis automatically — safe to commit with placeholder values.

_common_fields_for_reference.start_date: ISO-8601 date — how far back to sync  e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z
